_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,534 stores in 50 states and Canada with 174 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and commercial business customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.15x; -5% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.52; conservative 2yr +27%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -6.5%/yr (worst year FY98-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-21.2%/yr (Q3 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +21.0%/yr (FY98-FY07 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +35.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY98-FY07); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2008-09-26) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.15x (18.2% downside to Bear $20 / +124.9% upside to Bull $55) | Adj composite 1.65 vs market 2.17: gap -0.52 [OVERVALUED] | -5% above the EPP floor $26 (17x FY08E $1.52) | Conservative 2-yr case: +27.1% total (+13.6%/yr) | At 16.1x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $32 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; comps -5.3% in Q2 FY08, forward sales +1-2% (Q3 FY08 sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
